remarks: Super opportunity for one level living with new renovations in desirable Winnipauk Village! Brand new kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The living room with dining area has a cozy fireplace, and slider leads to a private deck with a serene woodland view. Both bedrooms are spacious: primary includes a ceiling fan and new mirrored closet doors, new paneled bedroom doors and hardware completes the look. Bath has a brand new tub and fixtures. New vinyl plank flooring rounds out the updates. Well maintained condo complex, new carpeting recently installed in common entry areas. Amenities include 2 pools, 1 large pool and 1 children's pool, clubhouse with workout room and racquetball court, tennis/pickleball courts under construction. Unit comes with one reserved parking spot across from the entryway, and plenty of visitor parking. Special Driveway assessment starts 8/1/25-6/1/26, $216.93/monthly.
